# R379 — full-main-context primary KV/state semantics (source-only)

Date: 2026-10-13 (Asia/Tokyo). Read-only inspection of candidate Q `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-full-main-context-probe-20261013`, supplied HEAD `410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2` (dirty seven files), against W `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013`, supplied HEAD `0f1127823e6c77f324093d9ffcf42cb773ce8ced`. Candidate is unbuilt, untested and unrun. Read R364, `implementation-full-main-context-probe-v1.txt`, W's `candidate-source-unqualified/full-main-context.json`, R376, R377 and W registry-v188 (`research_completed=917`). R376/R377 remain unregistered supplemental reports. No Main active run/log/config was read. No build, test, GPU/model, import/AST, profiler, process/service, Git operation, cleanup or source edit was performed. This report is the sole write. The aim is source boundary/state semantics; this cannot qualify physical 256K fit, generated quality, or runtime correctness.

## Findings

**No source-level `max_new=0` endpoint access was found in the new main-only branch.** Its admission requires exactly 262144 IDs and capacity, `max_new==0`, native/main-only input, no MTP/speculation, fixed prefill, no borrowing, one GPU, and excludes the incompatible modes listed in `generate.cpp`. It calls `prefill.run(o.tokens.data(), 262144, 0, err)` directly; it bypasses the ordinary post-prefill `kvg_ensure(n + output + 64)` and decode/token loop. Unlike the older `--full-context-probe ID` path, it creates no successor rows and never evaluates `tokens[n]`. `Prefill::run` validates the full span with subtraction-safe `publication::valid_span`, processes chunks at `p0=pos0+c0`, and invokes the callback after the chunk stream has synchronized. `MainCoverage` advances only when `begin==end`, with positive in-range counts, and requires final end 262144; successful PrefillStats must also report 262144 tokens and exactly `ceil(262144/chunk)` chunks. Thus final input position 262143 is processed without a decode/final-token read in this branch. This is a source-flow finding, not runtime proof.

**The intended int8/resident-32768 primary is a full authoritative host KV plus a bounded GPU page cache, not a 32768-cell logical context.** `layer.cpp::kv_plan` selects primary `kv_mode=1` when `--kv-resident` (clamped to at least 20480) is below the full page count. It allocates `n_pages` of pinned authoritative host KV, `n_slots` device pages, and a streaming residency map. `Prefill::take_stage` is only for mode 1's separate staging route; the QSA primary itself is read/written through its authoritative host pools and resident page slots. Its streaming map resolves pages into bounded slots, allowing eviction while preserving all logical cells in the host pools. `max_context=262144` and each state's `max_cells=262144` set the logical/physical extent. The automatic elastic-KV enable explicitly excludes both probes, and explicit elastic mode is rejected, so this run has no later KV growth path. `--kv-resident=32768` should therefore constrain residency while the entire primary sequence remains represented in host KV.

For mode 1 the snapshot helper chooses `st.host.*` as its authoritative sources. The main-only snapshot records full rounded-to-page KV extent and all five payload parts per layer: K, V, their scale arrays where applicable, and pooled index rows. Since 262144 is the requested physical extent, successful geometry/byte validation includes the last physical page. It also captures the live GDN recurrence plus convolution history, PLE history, each QSA indexer's tail/dead/block position, pooled rows, and live IDs. `ss.ple_prev` is set to the last two actual IDs before capture. `saved_logical_ids` is reported separately from KV extent.

**Restore covers authoritative bytes and running checkpoint state, while mode-1 GPU residency remains deliberately disposable.** `conversation_kv_restore` copies the complete snapshot back to the authoritative pools and calls `kv_stream_reset` for mode 1, so stale resident slots are invalidated before a future page lookup. The candidate poisons authoritative payload and resident slot buffers; `conversation_kv_verify` checks full authoritative bytes, and for mode 2 additionally checks ring bytes. For mode 1 it does not compare resident slot bytes: they are a cache, and reset makes their old contents unreachable. Restore then verifies authoritative bytes again, checks the full running checkpoint and invalidates mode-1 residency once more. This matches the production ownership model. The diagnostic does **not** exercise a post-restore page miss/refill or attention read, so it cannot establish that a later attention consumer repopulates and reads the final page correctly. A minimal runtime follow-up is a bounded production resolve/readback of the final logical page after restore (and, if feasible, one earlier page after eviction), checking its resident bytes against the authoritative host page and checked completion; this can avoid generation/output. If the production API cannot safely isolate that read, test the page-table/resolve behavior in the existing mode-1 streaming test path and keep inference-after-restore at zero.

The finite scan covers captured GDN/conv, PLE and indexer float vectors, pooled float rows, and int8 KV scale values. `block_pos` is an integer. In the intended int8 route, K/V codes themselves are integer payloads; all payload bytes are compared through capture/poison/restore, but byte equality is not a numeric oracle. The candidate does not provide a general finite-value scan for fp16 KV or packed q4 values/scales; that is outside the requested int8 case and is stated as a limitation in the handoff. These checks show that the captured production buffers can be poisoned and restored byte-for-byte; they do not prove attention/RoPE numerical correctness or next-turn output.

## Minimal review/verification points for Main

1. Preserve the intended invocation and confirm emitted `kv_mode=1`, `n_pages`, `n_slots`/effective resident cells, `host=1`, full KV byte extents and final page for every QSA layer. `--kv-resident` can be rounded to page size, and the CLI guard itself does not mandate exactly 32768 or mode 1.
2. In the serialized GPU qualification, add a narrow mode-1 final-page resolve/readback check after restore if a safe production seam exists. This closes the uncovered resident refill/attention boundary; full output generation is not needed. Include one page replacement/eviction cycle if this path can be tested without changing the zero-output endpoint contract.
3. Keep the distinction in the result: all 262144 IDs were processed by main Prefill; complete authoritative KV and running state were captured/poisoned/restored; physical memory fit and numerical attention/quality remain unqualified until Main's runtime evidence exists.

## Source map

Candidate `src/program/generate.cpp`: admission around 2702-2728; elastic-KV exclusion around 3743-3768; full-main diagnostic around 1435-1628; dispatch before MTP callback and ordinary prefill around 10537-10605. `include/strata/program/full_context_probe.hpp`: `MainCoverage`. Candidate `src/prefill/prefill.cpp`: span validation/chunk loop around 1225-1300 and synchronized callback around 3002-3013; mode-1 host staging setup around 504-529. Candidate `src/core/layer.cpp`: `kv_plan`, allocation and host-pool construction around 530-780. Candidate `src/core/conversation_snapshot.cpp`: page-rounded layout/pool selection around 25-115, restore/reset and mode-2 ring restore around 265-300, byte verifier and mode-2 resident-ring comparison around 303-360. Candidate `src/core/conversation_state.cpp`: main-only capture/validate/restore around 380-445 and checkpoint state copy/restore around 190-220.

R364's earlier fixture/RAM/admission and older MTP boundary findings were not repeated here. No full-context runtime or performance claim is made.
